title: Orbits and years
info: An orbit is the path one body takes around another.
Earth's year is one orbit of the Sun, about 365.25 days. Leap days catch up the extra quarter day.
Planets closer to the Sun generally have shorter years. Mercury's year is about 88 Earth days. Neptune's year is about 165 Earth years.
Orbits are ellipses, a stretched circle, not perfect circles.
